Do not let the knee collapse inward.

description: Develops unilateral explosive power and ankle stiffness.

name: Wrist Circles

instructions.setup: Extend arms in front or keep them by the side.
execution: Rotate the wrists in a full circular motion.
Perform clockwise and counter-clockwise rotations.
Open and close the fingers occasionally.
tips: Keep the rest of the arm still.
Move through the full range of motion.

description: Essential warm-up for any exercise involving a grip or weight-bearing on hands.

name: Eagle Pose

instructions.setup: Stand on one leg with a slight bend.
execution: Wrap the other leg over and around the standing leg.
Cross arms at the elbows and wrists in front of the face.
Squeeze everything toward the midline and sit lower.
tips: Gaze at one point through the hands.
Lift the elbows to shoulder height.

description: A challenging balance pose that stretches the upper back and outer hips.

name: Power Step-Ups

instructions.setup: Place one foot on a box.
execution: Drive through the foot on the box to jump vertically.
Switch feet in the air or land with the same foot on the box.
Maintain control on the way down.
tips: Do not push off the floor foot; use the box foot.
Keep the chest up.

description: Unilateral explosive training for the quads and glutes.

name: Iron Cross Stretch

instructions.setup: Lie on your back with arms out to the sides.
execution: Lift one leg straight up and drop it across the body to the opposite hand.
Keep both shoulders on the floor.
Alternate sides in a controlled manner.
tips: Keep the legs as straight as possible.
Exhale as the leg drops across the body.

description: A dynamic stretch for the glutes and lower back rotation.

name: Chair Pose

instructions.setup: Stand with feet together.
execution: Bend the knees and sit the hips back as if into a chair.
Reach the arms overhead, parallel to each other.
Keep the weight in the heels.
tips: Keep the chest lifted.
Tuck the tailbone slightly to avoid excessive arching.

description: Builds lower body heat and tests shoulder and core endurance.

name: Reactive Box Drops

instructions.setup: Stand on a low box.
execution: Step off the box.
Land on both feet and 'freeze' in a perfect squat position.
Absorb all energy without any extra movement.
tips: Ensure the heels hit the floor.
The landing should be quiet.

description: Teaches proper landing mechanics and eccentric force absorption.

name: Mountain Pose

instructions.setup: Stand with feet together and arms at the sides.
execution: Engage the quads and lift the kneecaps.
Tuck the tailbone and engage the core.
Draw the shoulder blades down the back.
tips: Distribute weight evenly across the four corners of the feet.
Breathe deeply.

description: The foundational standing pose for all yoga practice.

name: Neck Circles

instructions.setup: Sit or stand with an upright posture.
execution: Slowly drop the chin to the chest.
Roll the head in a circular motion, ear to shoulder.
Perform in both directions.
tips: Move very slowly.
Stop if you feel any sharp pain or dizziness.

description: Relieves tension in the upper traps and improves cervical mobility.

name: Warrior III

instructions.setup: Stand on one leg.
execution: Hinge forward at the hips, lifting the back leg until it's parallel to the floor.
Reach arms forward or out to the side.
Keep the hips squared to the ground.
tips: Flex the back foot to engage the leg.
Imagine a straight line from fingertips to heel.

description: A powerful balance pose that strengthens the entire posterior chain.

name: Upward-Facing Dog

instructions.setup: Lie face down with hands by the ribs.
execution: Press into the hands to straighten the arms.
Lift the torso and the tops of the thighs off the floor.
Look slightly upward without crunching the neck.
tips: Keep the shoulders away from the ears.
Engage the legs fully so knees don't touch the mat.

description: A powerful backbend that strengthens the arms and stretches the entire front body.

name: Hip Flexor Stretch

instructions.setup: Start in a half-kneeling position.
execution: Tuck the pelvis under (posterior tilt).
Lean forward slightly until a stretch is felt in the front of the hip.
Reach the same-side arm overhead for a deeper stretch.
tips: Do not arch the lower back to get further forward.
Squeeze the glute of the back leg.

description: Targets the psoas and rectus femoris, crucial for those who sit often.

name: Broad Jump to Slam

instructions.setup: Stand with a medicine ball.
execution: Perform a broad jump while holding the ball.
Land softly and immediately slam the ball into the floor.
Repeat in a continuous flow.
tips: Maintain balance during the landing before the slam.
Use a non-bouncing ball.

description: A complex power movement combining horizontal explosion with vertical core power.
